newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel ready to sell Havas shares -paper.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel ready to sell Havas shares -paper.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk said in an interview to be published on Saturday his group would sell its stake in media group Havas once the stock was correctly valued on the bourse.
An advance copy of the interview to appear in the Journal des Finances weekly on Saturday was supplied to Reuters.

On Alcatel's seven percent stake in Havas, the weekly quoted Tchuruk as saying, "we are free to sell on the stock exchange and we will sell this stake when we believe that the bourse has put a correct value on the share, which is not yet the case".
